messages:
asha-cs: Heads-up — LumenPay just sent their SIG + a bespoke security questionnaire. Due EOD Friday. They also reported an API 401 spike last week and flagged an unexpected charge on their invoice. Need help compiling log retention evidence, KMS/HSM attestation, and a short repro note for the 401s.

elena-se: can you paste the exact Qs they asked about retention & logs? i can draft the answers once we know scope. :+1:

asha-cs: Paste below (redacted):
```
1) Please confirm maximum retention for API audit logs and where they are stored.
2) Provide export method for logs (format, filters) and an example export for a customer request.
3) Describe KMS/HSM usage for key lifecycle and provide attestation/cert if available.
4) Any SLAs for forensic log access and proof of deletion/retention policy.
```

tom-security: For KMS/HSM — standard response: we use customer-keyed encryption options for Private deployments and KMS integrations for Hosted/Dedicated. Attestation: we can provide current HSM vendor cert and key-management diagram. We don't ship private keys; provide procedure for auditable key rotation. I'll pull the latest HSM attestation doc.

ravi-sre: On the 401 spike — we saw a burst on 2024-11-02 ~14:23 UTC originating from a single client-id (LumenPay). Trace id: trace-8a1f3b. Symptoms: repeated token refresh failures -> downstream 401s. Quick repro steps we captured in logs:
```
2024-11-02T14:22:59Z svc-auth token-refresh error grant_expired
2024-11-02T14:23:01Z ingress request id=abc123 401 x-rate-limit? false
```
Suspect token rotation mismatch on their side, but we saw elevated 401s from our gateway for ~12 minutes. I exported the correlated traces to S3: s3://redwood-support-exports/lumenpay/trace-8a1f3b.json

nate-ops: Billing note — OLIVIA (cc @olivia-billing) there was an automated proration adjuster that applied a credit 2024-11-01 for some accounts; LumenPay reports a CHARGE instead. Can billing reconcile invoice #LP-2024-11-07 and confirm if any usage spike matches the times Ravi mentions.

olivia-billing: @nate-ops I pulled LP-2024-11-07 — payments team shows an on-demand usage line for "dedicated-burst" at 2024-11-02 14:20 which looks like a short-lived allocation. I'm opening a ticket to reconcile if charge was misapplied. Will update by EOD tomorrow.

elena-se: For the questionnaire exports — we should provide an example export command and sample CSV/JSON schema. Suggest this snippet for the response:
```
# export API audit for a customer, filtered by org_id
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-raw-logs/2024/11/02/ --exclude "*" --include "*lumenpay*" ./lumenpay-logs.json
```
Also attach a one-page retention table: default hosted retention 90 days, Dedicated configurable up to 365 days, Private customers control retention.

tom-security: Addendum on attestation — I will attach latest HSM vendor sig (HSM-Vendor-2024-ATT.pdf) and provide a short paragraph on key lifecycle. For 'proof of deletion' we can provide delete job logs + S3 lifecycle policy references.

asha-cs: Customer asked if we can extend the SIG deadline by 3 business days because they want to include their legal. Can we get a pre-approved extension?

elena-se: I'm fine to ask for extension. We usually grant +3 for enterprise questionnaires. I'll draft the ask and include the export + sample evidence.

ravi-sre: One more thing — we should include a short troubleshooting note for the 401s: known issue pattern (token clock drift / refresh race). Example mitigation: force a full token refresh, check SDK versions, and confirm token TTL. I can write a 3-step repro and attach the trace snippets.

deploy-bot: deploy:prod/ingress-auth v3.12.4 completed 2024-11-03 03:10 UTC :rocket:

nate-ops: tagging for follow-ups: @olivia-billing to reconcile invoice, @tom-security to attach HSM attestation, @ravi-sre to create repro snippet, @elena-se to draft questionnaire answers.

asha-cs: Thanks everyone — i'll message the customer with a +3 day extension proposal and let them know were compiling the artifacts (logs export, attestation, sample export command, billing check). Will post the finalized packet here before sending. :pray:
